QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] A Giant of a Rumor
QuestInfo.0: #bTatamo#k, the chief of #bLeafre#k, is looking for an experienced hero. Listen to Tatamo.
QuestInfo.1: #bTatamo#k, the chief of #bLeafre#k, is looking for an experienced hero. Listen to Tatamo.
QuestInfo.2: According to Tatamo, the chief of Leafre, the rock mountain in southern Leafre isn't a rock mountain, but the huge #rStone Colossus#k.

0.0: Has anyone told you about the #bStone Colossus#k? It's a great beast of rock whose head pierces the sky. We Halflinger's wouldn't be more than a pebble under its toenails! Wouldn't you like to see something like that?

yes.0: Come see me anytime. We'll have a little chat about big things, hehehe...\r\n#b(Visit Chief Tatamo in Leafre.)#k

no.0: I understand. I'm terrified of giants.

1.0: Oh, you came. Thank you very much.

yes.0: As you know, we Halflingers stay near Minar Forest and rarely go to other areas. Others call us unsociable because of that, but what can we do when we were born that way? We prefer a simple life, not adventures.
yes.1: Even so, there are Halflingers that love adventures. There's a #bHalflingers exploration team that travels Minar Forest#k. I heard they are quite skilled. The last place they went was the southern area of Leafre. But they brought back some unusual #rnews#k. Have you heard?
yes.2: The exploration team said the rock mountain in southern Leafre isn't a rock mountain at all. The body is a rock and the head is far above the clouds. It was the #rhuge Stone Colossus#k!
